title: Textbook Finder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Locates required books, editions, and formats for each course. The Textbook Finder locates required books and available editions. From the course syllabus it identifies each required text with the exact edition, then finds where it is available: campus bookstore, library reserve, rental, digital, or used. Format options — hardcover, paperback, ebook — are listed with what each includes.
capabilities: Identify required texts from the syllabus
Pin down the exact required edition
Find bookstore, library, rental, digital options
List formats with their trade-offs
Check library reserve availability
